items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Joe Wilder and all those guys. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. They put a suit on every day.

ctx.x: — you can get three or four nights out of a dress shirt if you wear a tee shirt.” And he says,” and don’t wear that shirt on the bus to the gig. Only change at the gig.” He goes, “because nobody can smell you from the audience. And it doesn’t matter that the other guys could smell your nasty shirt, you’re getting four days out of a dress shirt.” Survival on the road. And to this day I wear tee shirts. Guys say, “how do you wear those, they’re so constraining.” I say, “because I can get four nights out of a dress…
Yeah. Joe Wilder and all those guys.
Yeah. They put a suit on every day. But to fold up a suit jacket with no wrinkles in a little carry on bag. Nice.
